principle: Collect chart ideas broadly, promote them narrowly. Expert popularity or repeated mention is never evidence of edge.

stages.entry: Extracted from source content or expert screen/language.
stages.exit: At least one strategy structure is normalized into primitive/condition fields.

stages.entry: Source example is point-in-time checkable and required data is defined.
stages.exit: Historical universe scan is completed with sufficient sample and failure cases.

stages.entry: In-sample historical scan meets configured sample/effect/stability gates.
Out-of-sample test remains positive after costs/conditioning and no leakage is detected.
stages.exit: Human research approval explicitly promotes the rule.

stages.entry: Explicit approval after historical + OOS support; rule includes context and invalidation.
stages.exit: May be demoted if later monitoring invalidates edge.

stages.entry: Contradicted, untestable, leakage-contaminated, or historically unsupported.
